snippet.title: DERELIKT - Steam Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist DERELIKT: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3810510/DERELIKT/

Play like it's 1999! DERELIKT is a narrative retro FPS inspired by Alien Resurrection, Doom 3 and System Shock 2, with a dash of lovecraftian cosmic horror.

Explore the dark hallways of Von Neuman Outpost, an expansive research station grafted onto an anomalous derelict asteroid in orbit around Saturn. Meet over a dozen unique NPCs, manage your inventory, solve oldschool puzzles and fight against eldritch abominations!

Keep up with development: https://x.com/Visuwyg and https://bsky.app/profile/visuwyg.bsky.social
